home.heroSubtitle: Pharma Core centralizes your inventory, sales, patients, and suppliers in one secure platform. Real-time tracking, smart alerts, and detailed analytics — built for Burundian pharmacies.
home.servicesSubtitle: A complete suite of tools built for pharmacists — simple, fast, and reliable.

service.posDesc: Fast checkout with real-time stock lookup, automatic FBU calculation, and detailed sales receipts.
service.inventoryDesc: Manage your catalog and track batches, expiry dates, and stock levels precisely.
service.patientsDesc: Secure patient database with purchase history, allergies, and clinical notes.
service.suppliersDesc: Manage suppliers and create restock orders that update stock automatically.
service.analyticsDesc: Dashboards with revenue, best-selling medications, and stock valuation.
service.alertsDesc: Automatic notifications for low stock and upcoming expirations — configurable per pharmacy.

feature.isolationDesc: Each pharmacy only accesses its own data, protected by authentication and strict security policies (Row-Level Security).
feature.exportDesc: Download your pharmacy's complete history at any time for archiving, auditing, or migration.
feature.alertsDesc: Low stock or medications nearing expiry? Pharma Core alerts you at the right time.

home.ctaSubtitle: Create your free account and start managing your pharmacy in minutes.
